summary: The blueprint broadly covers healthy human pancreas but needs targeted cleanup of a few markers, labels, and one arbitrary contrast axis.

issues.description: The module is mostly canonical for lymphatic endothelium, but TFF3 is an epithelial/ductal trefoil marker rather than a lymphatic endothelial marker, risking ductal signal in the lymphatic axis.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace TFF3 with a more canonical lymphatic/endothelial gene such as NRP2, RELN, TBX1, FOXC2, or another literature-supported lymphatic marker.

issues.description: HLA-DRA is not a pan-leukocyte marker and biases the common leukocyte gate toward antigen-presenting cells, overlapping with dendritic and B-cell modules.
issues.suggested_fix: Swap HLA-DRA for a broader leukocyte marker such as CD53, LAPTM5, DOCK2, RAC2, or another supported pan-immune gene.

issues.description: The module and axis names are misleading: t_nk_cell is a T-cell module despite a separate NK module, and b_plasma_cell is a B-cell module despite a separate plasma-cell module.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename or relabel these in place as T-cell and B-cell modules/axes, or adjust the gene lists if the intent is genuinely combined T/NK or B/plasma programs. No deletion is needed.

issues.description: Smooth muscle/contractile mural cells and endothelial cells are distinct vascular-associated compartments, but they are not a clear biological opposition; an endothelial axis already exists.
issues.suggested_fix: Convert this in place to a plain smooth muscle/contractile mural axis, or gate it within a vascular/stromal context if supported by existing modules.

out_of_scope: Epsilon cells and adipocytes are rare or sampling-dependent in many adult human pancreas datasets, but they are still within the broad human pancreas scenario and do not require removal.
